notes: TEN BLOCKS AND NO code_section. The page has ten `sections` rows — why, what, robotics,
process, compare, candidacy, benefits, cost, gallery, faq — in exactly the order of its ten
template bands, and it renders no <LocalTrust>, so nothing here needs the escape hatch and
nothing here touches cms/mu-plugins/vs-content-model.php or CodeSectionBlock.astro.
THE BAND VOCABULARY ON THIS SHEET IS NOT THE ONE THE TEMPLATE'S OWN COMMENTS CLAIMED, and
that is the single largest correction on this route. Three section comments in the .astro
said `cream` and one said `sage`. The sheet has always said otherwise:
`.fmdi .section.alt { background: var(--vs-charcoal-green) }` at full-mouth-dental-implants.css:228
and `.fmdi .section.dark { background: var(--vs-sage-pale) }` at :238. Five of these ten
bands are therefore charcoal or sage-pale, and a value copied from the comment instead of
the rule would have repainted `what`, `candidacy` and `cost` cream and `process` and
`gallery` sage. Every `band` below carries the rule it was read from in `band_evidence`.
The comments in the template have been corrected in place in the same change.
THIS PAGE HAS `cards` ROWS AND THEY ARE MOVED, NOT TRANSCRIBED. Confirmed against the live
CMS: ten rows in three groups — whyCards (4), benefitCards (4), alternatives (2). The first
two groups are claimed by the two card_grid blocks. The `alternatives` pair is the one thing
on this page a registered layout cannot hold, and it is listed in `exempt.cards` rather than
folded in among the head-to-head cards. See the `compare` block's known_gaps.
The template still declares whyCards / benefitCards / alternatives as local const arrays.
Those arrays are the ELSE branch — the rollback path — and they are character-for-character
the CMS rows they shadow, re-read row by row before this entry was written.
THREE BANDS ON THIS PAGE ARE BESPOKE SHAPES AND ALL THREE ARE RECORDED, NOT PAPERED OVER:
`robotics` is a `.robotics-*` family with a `.label` + <h4> callout; `compare` is two shapes
in one band; `candidacy` puts a full-width `.candidacy-sub` card below its grid. Each names
exactly what the page loses and the field or component change that closes it. Nothing below
invents a layout, and nothing below adds a sub-field to one.
THE ONE RECENTLY ADDED FIELD THIS PAGE NEEDED IS `media_split.checklist`, and it fits

`candidacy` exactly: `
    ` with `Lead — body` per line and the
01/02/03/04 markers DERIVED from row position. Two more recent additions are used as well —
`process_steps.columns` accepting '5' for the five-across recovery timeline, and
`card_grid.cards.body_2`, which this page does NOT need because every one of its eight cards
is a single paragraph.
CTA ROWS. All ten `sections` rows return ctaLabel and ctaHref null — verified live — so there
was never anything to move, and the two bands that ship buttons (`what`, `faq`) carry
transcribed pairs. `compare` and `process` draw their rows entirely from the component.
`robotics` and `candidacy` have no cta-row at all and are supplied none.
THE RAIL. Nine `toc_links` rows — why, what, robotics, process, compare, candidacy, benefits,
cost, faq — against ten bands. `gallery` has no row and stays out of the rail, which is where
it is today. Rail order and template order are the same on this page, so the derived rail is
not a difference.

known_gaps: THE CARD SHELL IS THE BLOCK'S, NOT THE PAGE'S, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE OF IT.
Markup is identical — section > wrap > section-head > .why-grid > article.why-card >
.num + h3 + p — so no copy is lost and no element changes. What changes is which sheet
styles the card: `.fmdi .why-card` (:281) is padding 30px 26px 32px, min-height 260px,
h3 19px, p 14px; CardGridBlock's own `.why-card` is padding 42px 38px, h3 22px, p 15px
and no min-height. That is R3 working as intended — a block owns its look so it can be
dropped on any page — and it is recorded here rather than argued with, because the next
person to diff this band should not have to rediscover why the cards got roomier.
The `cols-4` modifier in the class attribute is the one string difference. Nothing closes
it and nothing should: a bare `.why-grid` in the block is two columns.

1. THE CALLOUT'S LABEL LINE IS LOST OUTRIGHT.
`Same-day teeth` (vivid-smiles-website/src/pages/implant-dentistry/full-mouth-dental-implants.astro:428) has no field on media_split:

comparison_cards, which has the identical aside and the identical hole), drawn by
MediaSplitBlock as the aside's first child. Additive: blank on every band saved today,
and blank must draw no <span> at all. NOT added here — a sub-field is a schema change
for all 48 routes and does not belong in a page's map entry.

callout_body.literal: Full-arch implants are the right call when most or all teeth in an arch are gone, but other approaches fit different clinical pictures.

bullets.item: Fixed, bone-anchored, and designed for patients missing most or all teeth in an arch.
Four to six titanium roots per arch supporting a non-removable bridge.
Transfers chewing forces into the jawbone, preventing the resorption that dentures accelerate.
No adhesive, shifting, or daily removal; no food restrictions once healed.
Removable, lower upfront cost, but permit ongoing bone resorption and deteriorate in fit as the jaw changes shape.
Stay on top of the gums and allow the jawbone beneath them to shrink.
Require adhesive or daily removal and refitting.
Restrict the diet and accelerate the sunken facial look common in long-term denture wearers.

known_gaps: THREE, AND THIS IS THE BAND WHERE THIS PAGE DIVERGES MOST FROM THE FAMILY THE LAYOUT WAS
BUILT FROM. All three are on the render side: everything below is written to the CMS.
1. THE BULLET LISTS ARE NOT QUERIED, SO EIGHT LINES OF COPY DO NOT REACH THE PAGE.
`tiers.bullets` exists on the deployed layout (vs-content-model.php:2100-2103) and
ComparisonCardsBlock already renders it (ComparisonCardsBlock.astro:239-245), but the
selection set in src/blocks/manifest.ts asks for `tiers { tag title body ribbon
featured }` and nothing more. An unqueried repeater arrives undefined, the component's
Array.isArray guard yields an empty list, and both cards render as a tag and a heading
over nothing. Since neither card has a `body` either, the band comes back with two
near-empty cards.
WHAT CLOSES IT: `bullets { lead item }` inside `tiers` in
src/blocks/manifest.ts's PageFieldsBlocksComparisonCardsLayout fragment. One line.
NOT done from this route — manifest.ts is one file shared by every page in this phase,
a wrong name in it fails query validation for all 48 routes at once, and `lead` is not
drawn by the component yet (point 2), so the two go in together or not at all.
2. EVEN QUERIED, THE LIST LOSES ITS LEAD-INS AND ITS CLASS.

The template's line is `
  • Profile — Fixed, bone-anchored…
    • ` inside
`<ul class="compare-list">`. ComparisonCardsBlock draws `<ul>` with no class and

`
  • {line}
    • ` from `item` alone, escaped — so the bolded lead-in disappears and the
line starts mid-sentence at 'Fixed, bone-anchored…'. The marker treatment differs too:
`.fmdi .compare-card .compare-list li::before` is a sage bullet character (:512-515);
the block's `.compare-card ul li::before` is a 12px hairline.
WHAT CLOSES IT: ComparisonCardsBlock reading `lead` off each bullet row and drawing
`{lead} {item}` with the literal space after ``, the way MediaSplitBlock
already draws `checklist` (MediaSplitBlock.astro:455). The `lead` sub-field is already
on the repeater — block_list_field() puts it on all three lists — so this is a
component change and a selection-set line, not a schema change. Both of this band's
cards would then read as they do today, `.compare-list` class aside.
3. THE `.alternatives-grid` SUB-BAND HAS NO SLOT AND ITS TWO CMS ROWS ARE EXEMPT.
vivid-smiles-website/src/pages/implant-dentistry/full-mouth-dental-implants.astro:566-593 is a second shape inside this one band: a centred `.compare-sub-head`
over `<div class="alternatives-grid">` holding two `<article class="config-card">`

(tag,

,

). comparison_cards has ONE card list and ONE aside. The aside is spent
on the sub-head above, which keeps its <h3> and its paragraph; the two cards have
nowhere to go, and the `Alternatives` at :568 goes with
them.
Those two cards are real CMS rows — the `alternatives` group, verified live — so they
are listed in `exempt.cards` below rather than silently dropped, and the backfill will
report them as claimed-by-nobody-on-purpose instead of failing.
THEY WERE DELIBERATELY NOT FOLDED IN AS tiers ROWS 3 AND 4. That would have preserved
the words at the cost of the argument: two head-to-head options plus two lesser
alternatives under their own heading is not four peers in one grid, and .fmdi .compare
is a two-track grid (:477), so they would have wrapped underneath the pair as though
they belonged to it.
WHAT CLOSES IT: a `sub_eyebrow` / `sub_heading` / `sub_body` trio plus a `sub_cards`
repeater on comparison_cards, drawn by ComparisonCardsBlock as `.compare-sub` >
`.compare-sub-head` + `.alternatives-grid` > `.config-card`. Four of the eight pages
left in this phase carry a `.compare-sub` of this shape, so it is a family field and
not a fix for this page — which is exactly why it is not invented here.

grid leave a third of the row empty. WHAT CLOSES IT: the `columns` sub-field that comment
asks for.
